text:
marina: Heads-up — kicking off a config-only change for routing shapers + batching. Change window 14:10-14:40 PT today. Canary start 3% with a plan to ramp to 10% over 10m. No model or code changes, just params.
aj: Ack, added to deploybot queue.
deploybot: deploybot: config-only rollout queued by marina. change_id=cfg-2024-334. scheduled start 14:12 PT. canary plan 3% -> 10% over 10m. rollback_on_alert=true.
tim: Quick confirm: this will lower routing_shaper_limit for best-effort tenants and reduce batch_max_size to 8, correct?
marina: Correct. Snippet of what we're applying:
```
routing_shaper_limit: 120rps
batch_max_size: 8
kvcache_prefix_ttl: 60s
canary_ramp: [3, 7, 10]
```
sre-oncall: Monitoring note — create a temporary alert: p50 latency > 220ms OR error rate +2% vs baseline for 5m. If triggered, revert to previous config and pin model versions for affected routes. I'll own the watch.
ci-bot: ci-bot: preflight checks passed (schema validation + lint). No diffs that impact runtime parsing.
deploybot: deploybot: canary started at 14:12 (3%). Observability: <https://obs.internal/streams/cfg-2024-334>.
marina: Watching KV cache hitrate and tail latencies. @sre-oncall pls ack the alert thresholds.
sre-oncall: ack. I'll watch for 15m. If p50>220ms or error rate > +2% I'll call rollback. Prefer pausing ramp rather than full rollback if it's borderline noisy.
tim: If we see kvcache evictions spike, pause ramp and set batch_max_size back to 16 as a mitigation. Logging rollback plan in the runbook.
aj: Adding to release notes: "Adjusted routing shaper limits and batching params for cost/latency tuning; canary ramp 3→10% (14:12 start)."
deploybot: deploybot: canary ramp now 7% at 14:20. No alerts currently.
sre-oncall: 14:22 — p50 up +15ms, p95 stable, error rate within normal. continuing watch :eyes:.
marina: If no regression by 14:32 we'll proceed to 50%.
deploybot: deploybot: attempting ramp to 50% at 14:28, pause check...
deploybot: deploybot: ramp to 50% paused due to kvcache miss rate +3% over baseline at 14:28. Per rollback policy, initiating revert to previous config at 14:29.
marina: Ack rollback. Reverting and pinning config to previous stable. Will open follow-up to test a more conservative batch size and tweak kvcache TTL.
aj: Noted in notes: rollback reason = kvcache miss spike during ramp. Follow-ups: offline perf test, prefix TTL tuning, canary metric additions.
tim: I'll open the PR for conservative params and attach metric diffs. Runbook link: <https://runbook.internal/config-rollbacks>.
sre-oncall: Pin applied and monitoring returning to baseline. No lingering alerts.
marina: Thanks all — we'll reschedule a slower ramp next week and add the extra canary metrics (kvcache evictions, per-tenant p50). :thumbsup:
